args.query: select * from api.limit_balance; select c.id,c.name,c.funding_limit,(select sum(ct.amount) from api.contract ct join api.application a on a.id=ct.application_id where a.company_id=c.id) from api.company c;
select ct.number,ct.amount,ct.status,a.company_id from api.contract ct join api.application a on a.id=ct.application_id where a.company_id=20005;
